avis.titre: Fine for the price; could be better
avis.texte: What I like: 1. Texture is nice. It's called a gel, but almost feels like makeup primer. It seems to be ok under makeup so far. 2. It's a decent price for 50ml of product for a drugstore brand. 3. It has some nice skincare ingredients in it. What I don't like: 1. The scent. It's not super-strong, but I just dislike "sunscreen smell." I do seem to become nose-blind to it after application. This is just a personal preference for most sunscreen for me.. 2. I don't really like a pump for sunscreens. A common way to know how much to put on is the "one stripe down two fingers" method, which achieves SPF coverage claimed on the bottle. A pump does not dispense it evenly to get the right amount. I just like a tube you can squeeze one straight line with; 3. Bulky packaging. With most Byoma products, the packaging looks modern, but is clunky and wasteful. The bulky size of this container prevents me from traveling with it. And if its just a plastic shell with a tiny 50ml bladder of product inside, that's wasteful for no reason. It's generally good. I will try to use some of it on my body where the smell is less noticeable but likely would not re-buy because there are too many other good unscented options.
